pages.text: The children kicked a ball in the square. Soso sat by the fountain.
Soso wanted to kick the ball too. Their mouth opened, then closed again.
A ball rolled over. Soso held it in both hands.
Ppino held out a hand. "Give it here."
Soso handed over the ball. Their hands were empty.
One by one, the children went home. Soso stayed by the fountain.
Soso hadn't kicked the ball even once. Their toes just rubbed the ground.
Grandma Bear sat beside Soso. "No one knows unless you tell them."
The next day, Soso went to the square. The ball rolled over again.
"Let me play too!" Soso gave the ball a great big kick.
